2608.27439.title: RedEvoAgent: Automatic Red-Teaming Agent with Experience-Driven Skill Evolution
2608.27439.paper_summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in product-level execution harnesses, where jailbreaks can trigger harmful tool use and persistent state changes, creating greater risks than unsafe text generation alone. Existing automatic red-teaming methods often rely on fixed attacks, while recent agentic attackers coordinate multiple jailbreak tools and show stronger potential through trajectory-based retrieval. However, such retrieval can reuse misleading experiences due to retrieval bias and unclear tool credit, and full trajectories add context overhead while reducing interpretability. We propose RedEvoAgent, a black-box red-teaming agent that distills cross-case attack trajectories into a concise, human-readable attack skill. The attack skill adaptively evolves through tool-effectiveness profiling and Deciding-Tool Attribution for skill updates, and a validation ratchet that retains only updates improving validation performance. Experiments on multiple benchmarks, target models, and target execution harnesses show that RedEvoAgent outperforms fixed and agentic baselines, improves tool efficiency, and transfers across attacker models and target execution harnesses.
2608.27439.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於代理的系統越來越多地被部署在產品級執行環境中，這裡的越獄行為可能觸發有害工具的使用和持久狀態變化，造成的風險超過僅僅是不安全的文本生成。現有的自動紅隊方法通常依賴於固定攻擊，而最近的代理攻擊者則協調多個越獄工具，並通過基於軌跡的檢索顯示出更強的潛力。然而，這種檢索可能因檢索偏見和不明確的工具信用而重用誤導性經驗，而完整的軌跡則增加了上下文開銷，同時降低了可解釋性。我們提出了 RedEvoAgent，一種黑箱紅隊代理，將跨案例攻擊軌跡提煉為簡潔、人類可讀的攻擊技能。該攻擊技能通過工具有效性分析和決策工具歸因進行自適應演變，以便進行技能更新，並通過驗證齒輪僅保留那些改善驗證性能的更新。在多個基準、目標模型和目標執行環境上的實驗顯示，RedEvoAgent 在性能上超越了固定和代理基準，提高了工具效率，並在攻擊者模型和目標執行環境之間實現了轉移。
